title: 7 Day Bali Adventure Itinerary (2026)

🌴 Seasonal Guide: When to Visit Bali
days.description: The peak season for good reason. Clear skies, consistent surf, and perfect trekking conditions. May–June and September are the sweet spot — dry weather without peak-season July–August crowds and prices. Mt Batur sunrises are clearest, rafting water levels are ideal, and Nusa Penida seas are calmest.

days.title: 💰 7-Day Budget Breakdown
days.description: Per-person daily costs. Bali is incredibly affordable — the adventure activities are your biggest expense, not food or accommodation.
